scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is exact for the full Boolean rectangle \(\{0,1\}^d\) at the sixth moment. The proof is analytic and dimension-uniform; packaged computations are corroborative rather than inferential. Literature non-detection is not treated as proof of global novelty, and older tensor-product or hypercontractive formulations remain a residual originality risk.
title: Sharp \(\Lambda(6)\) constant and rigidity for the Boolean rectangular spectrum
